versions.content: Provide vendor-specific published information Type: valid Description: BSWMD template SHALL support the definition of vendor-specific published information. Rationale: Vendors may want to publish proprietary information for usage in their tool chain. Dependencies: [RS_BSWMD_00048], [RS_BSWMD_00024] Use Case: Describe vendor-specific published information on the actual implementation of the module based on the implemented target. Avoid proprietary means to provide such extensions by specifying a standardized way of description. Supporting Material: [RS_ECUC_00002] [8]
